Perfect. The data confirms my strategy is sound: Season 2 early May (days 1-32) has virtually no yellowtail despite 192 trips. This validates holding back and focusing on October peak.

## Summary

**What I learned:** Corrected my seasonal model based on Season 1 data and forum consensus. October (not July) is peak season for yellowtail with 15-16 avg fish/trip. May-July is weak (0.5-6 avg/trip), so early bookings are a budget trap. Day_1_5 and overnight trips are best performers.

**What I changed:**
1. Rewrote `strategy.py` to commit PTO for October Fridays starting now (14-day lead requirement)
2. Updated `notes.md` with corrected seasonal calendar and execution plan: avoid weak months, save capital for October peak, target 4-5 trips Oct-Nov

**Current status:** Day 32, $2000 budget intact, 10 PTO days intact, rank 11/34. Zero trips booked (correct—early season has no fish). Strategy ready to auto-commit October PTO and book peak-season trips when available.

**Next moves:** Monitor August-September fleet activity for building signals; execute Oct-Nov trip bookings when booking windows open.
